flows.name: Agents work on a codebase from triggers and tasks; developers review every change (JetBrains Air)
flows.summary: JetBrains Air's page, in its own example: the team runs the agents it already uses in one system, from the IDE, the web, a CLI or a phone; automations start agents on repository events, and the developer reviews each change.

steps.what: Connects the agents it uses (Claude Agent, Codex, Junie, Copilot, OpenCode or any via ACP) and sets automations on repository events, for example a code reviewer when a pull request is created or issue triage when an issue is created.
Gives an agent a task in plain words, from a JetBrains IDE, the web, the CLI or a phone.
Runs in the cloud, scans the project, makes the change and reports what it did and the credits it used.
steps.agent: Make the change and report it.

steps.what: Reviews every change and follows up on the task.
